verdict.line: You lose if you let Dark Procession wall you in for a free Mist Walker dogpile; you win by forcing extended fights after you've closed the gap.

brief.thesis: This is a 45.3% head-to-head over 86 games despite Darius holding the lane and solo-kill advantage, because Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall turns every all-in attempt into a coin flip on positioning. The matchup isn't about raw damage — it's about whether you get caged before your Hemorrhage stacks matter or whether you close distance clean and grind him down in a prolonged fight.

theirWindow.when: W wall is up and you're overextended
theirWindow.what: He will wall off your retreat or box you against his Mist Walkers the instant you commit. Do not engage at the edge of minion waves where a wall can seal you off from your own jungle or tower.

yourWindow.when: His W (Dark Procession) is on cooldown (18.5-26s at low ranks, 16s minimum at max rank)
yourWindow.what: This is when you force the fight. Use E (Apprehend) to pull him in the moment the wall is down, then stack Hemorrhage with Q (Decimate) and auto-attacks — he has no way to disengage or wall-split you now.

start.why: 82.2% pick rate at 43.4% win over 83 games — the sustain and early trade damage matter more here than armor, since Yorick doesn't burst you, he grinds you with Q (Last Rites) heals.

boots.why: 72.6% pick rate at 46.4% win over 69 games — Yorick's damage comes from autos and Mist Walker swarms, and the attack-speed reduction directly blunts both.

core.why: The active haste closes the gap before his W (Dark Procession) wall can seal the engage.
Move speed stacking lets you chase him down in open lane before he reaches a wall-friendly choke point.

runes.keystoneWhy: 50% win over 22.6% pick — stacking Conqueror rewards the exact prolonged-fight pattern OP.GG's own tip calls for, since Yorick has no hard burst to punish you for staying in extended trades.

summoners.why: 54.4% win at 64.8% pick — Ghost directly counters his W wall by letting you walk through terrain-adjacent zoning and close distance without a dash, which is exactly the tool this matchup demands.

playing.title: Track his W cooldown, not his HP
playing.detail: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s on cooldown. If it's down, he can't wall-split you — that's your all-in window, not a flashy HP threshold.

playing.title: Pull before he digs a grave
playing.detail: His Q (Last Rites) digs a grave on champion hit and heals him. Use E (Apprehend) to engage before he gets the free auto off, denying both the heal and the grave setup.

playing.title: Fight long, not fast
playing.detail: Don't expect a burst kill. Stack Hemorrhage to 5 with Q (Decimate) and autos, then finish with R (Noxian Guillotine) once stacks are maxed for the true-damage execute.

playing.title: Respect wall geometry near objectives
playing.detail: Never commit near river bush or tower range where a single W (Dark Procession) cast can seal you away from help — that's where OP.GG's 'avoid being caged' tip actually bites.

playing.title: Ghost into every post-6 skirmish
playing.detail: With Ghost up, chase angles ignore his wall placement entirely since you're not pathing around terrain the same way — use it to force the fight on your terms.

playing.title: Punish Maiden summons alone
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles (R) is 160/130/100s early — if he's used it and the Maiden is on a separate skirmish, that's a lane you can win 1v1 with no help coming.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, timing windows, and tactical calls are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being caged inside Yorick’s (E). Rather than dealing burst damage, try to fight him in a prolonged fight after closing in successfully. Pressure him to gain control over lane.
